test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A leopard cannot change its spots

options.text: It is possible to complete a tedious job
being ready to do anything is not common
It is impossible to change who you are

solution:
The correct answer is: **It is impossible to change who you are**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "A leopard cannot change its spots" means that a person's character, behavior, or nature cannot be changed.
 
• It is derived from the fact that a leopard's spots are a part of its physical appearance and cannot be altered.

Therefore,** option 4** is the correct meaning of the idiom.
